title: LOST MAN
titleNative: LOST MAN
synopsis: There lives a man who has lost his memory and can’t remember where he’s from, and who he is, including his name. He just goes by the name Matsumoto and the one and only thing he remembers is how to play soccer. However, the one thing he does remember, he does exceptionally well, even better than the professionals. He sells his ridiculous soccer skills to teams and guarantees them goals and, even more important, wins. As he travels from city to city, country to country playing for money, he hopes that he regains his memory.

title: Kochira, Shuumatsu Teitai Iinkai
titleNative: こちら、終末停滞委員会。
synopsis: Kotoyorozu Kotoha, a boy with an underground past as a former mafia underling, had given up on youth. However, his life changes completely after meeting certain girls. With massive guns, they fight against mysterious beings threatening to destroy humanity! This is their school life — full of chaos, action, and unexpected twists. Behind the facade of the world lies a wild and outrageous youth like no other! A mega-serialized story packed with sci-fi, romance, action, and more — let the fun begin!

title: Kurokouchi
titleNative: クロコーチ
synopsis: Kurokouchi Keita is the black sheep of the police force. He works alone, and doesn't think twice about extorting money from the dirty politicians by getting hold of their achilles heels. Using the money and whatever bits of information acquired through underhanded means, he gets closer and closer to the ultimate unresolved crime of the Showa era (1968); the 300 million bank heist. One day, the new rookie Seike Shingo, is assigned as Kurokouchi's partner. Excellent, but naive and idealistic, he is the exact opposite of Kurokouchi, but nonetheless, the duo relentlessly chase down criminals.

synopsis: An empire falling to ruin: The Kio Empire. Living in that empire, is an overweight 5-year-old abandoned by his parents, Prince Ageha. Ageha has memories from a previous life of him living as a Japanese man in another world. He then encounters his younger half-brother, Regulus. Ageha had a vision that Regulus will kill him in the future over inheritance, so Ageha sets out to raise him after Regulus's mother passed. Once the sparkling and fluffy-haired Regulus cozied up to Ageha, He turned into a doting older brother before he even realized! Enjoy a fantasy story of young brothers managing their kingdom, sometimes involving the gods, as they reform it step by step to bring a better land to the next generation! (Source: MangaPlaza)

synonyms: See you at the laundromat tonight
synopsis: Narita, a family restaurant employee in his late twenties who is always busy with work, is feeling down about the results of his job interview, while he is having dinner, he is absentmindedly watching a video recommended to him on a video site. The video shows Sasa Yoruzaki, an artist with an overwhelming sense of fashion and singing ability, despite her cool and slightly cheeky responses. Later, when he goes to an old laundromat to deal with some laundry problems, he suddenly notices a woman and feels something is off about her. The woman seems familiar, but it is Sasa herself, the one he had just seen in the video.
